propositions: T5c security findings must be grounded in the current codebase and configuration via read tools, with a criterion-local override to the shared preamble's evaluate-as-written stance, so that controls defined elsewhere flip findings.

Undeclared-access-posture findings are deduplicated at source to emit at most one per plan, with additional surfaces folded into the single finding's evidence rather than emitting one finding per surface.
Candidate T5c findings citing neither a read repo artifact nor a quoted plan sentence are demoted to MINOR severity (not suppressed), while grounded findings retain their full strength.
Only two HIGH classes warrant severity >= MAJOR in T5c: plaintext secrets on boundary-crossing paths and undeclared internet-reachable sensitive surfaces; all other findings max out at MINOR.
T5c routing entry changes from advisory @ 0.95 to blocking @ 0.9 via criteria_routing.json default_posture and block_threshold fields, with no inert blocking_enabled key.

All three pinned blocking-set test assertions (test_threshold_recalibration.py, test_impact_model_versioning.py, test_criteria_blocking.py parametrizations) are extended to include T5c and remain green post-rewrite.
